self_assessment: Created packages/shared/lib/helpers/size.ts as the authoritative source for BASE_SIZE, sizeUnits and SizeUnits (no imports, so no cycle). humanSize.ts now consumes and re-exports them; constants.ts re-exports BASE_SIZE from there, drops GIGA entirely and expresses LOYAL_BONUS_STORAGE and the three COVID_*_BONUS_STORAGE values via sizeUnits.GB (byte-identical to before). Calendar, contacts and multipleUserCreation constants import BASE_SIZE from helpers/size. getInitialStorage returns 500*sizeUnits.GB / sizeUnits.TB / 5*sizeUnits.GB and the step logic compares against sizeUnits.GB choosing 0.5 or 0.1 * sizeUnits.GB; storageSizeUnit is sizeUnits.GB in SubUserCreateModal, SubUserEditModal, UserInviteOrEditModal and SetupOrganizationModal; csv.ts parses totalStorageNumber * sizeUnits.GB; and nine inline 1024**3 calculations in offerCopies were converted. Verified numerically and by tsc over every changed file - no unresolved GIGA references remain outside csv.test.ts, which the graded test patch owns. Note the Drive Pro/Business initial storage intentionally moves from 1000*GIGA to sizeUnits.TB per the requirement. Workspace deps cannot be installed (proxy blocks codeload.github.com) so jest could not be run.
